payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs despite their presence in certain locations, indicating a preservation bias and the influence of sedimentation and erosion processes.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs despite their presence at Lembetabe, indicating a preservation bias.
The presence of modern active dune fields and fossilized aeolianites covering MIS 5e reefs suggests limited exposure time for previously deposited limestone.
The interpretation of missing facies or incomplete sequences complicates understanding of paleo relative sea level evolution.
